label: Tutorial: Connectors
description: Steps of the Tutorial button on the Connectors page (endpoint connector.connector_list). A step: target (CSS selector, empty = centred card), title, text (blank line = new paragraph, **bold**, `code`), roles (optional: anonymous, user, member, admin, perm:<key>), demo (rule / bundle: example shown when the target is missing, e.g. an empty list).

steps.title: Connectors
steps.text: Link this instance to other Rulezet instances and pull their rules and bundles — the quickest way to fill a new Rulezet, and to keep it in sync.

steps.title: How connectors work
steps.text: Pull modes, matching and filters, explained.

steps.title: Rulezet instances
steps.text: **Add** an instance with its URL and an API key of an account on it, **test** the connection, then **pull**. **Soft** pull adds missing rules; **hard** pull also updates the ones you have. Matching is by UUID only: pulling twice never duplicates a rule. Each pull is a background job with its own history.
